description: Seven dry-bean varieties from real morphology features with duplicate-aware splits, calibrated SVM and held-out error analysis

issues.title: Validate on independent labelled grain batches
issues.body: UCI source lacks batch/farm/camera IDs. Acquire an independently licensed batch-labelled set and evaluate the frozen feature contract/model before deployment claims.

issues.title: Evaluate unknown varieties and separate calibration data
issues.body: Current seven-class score transformation calibrates on the same validation set used for selection. Add a disjoint calibration set and unknown-variety evaluation before adopting abstention thresholds.
